Select distinct compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726550. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES.
